name: ReClaim
fullName: Industrial Surplus Intelligence & Resource Recovery Platform
domain: Industrial Sustainability / Circular Economy / Resource Management
description: ReClaim connects businesses with leftover industrial and building materials to organizations that can reuse them. The platform helps you sign up your organization, list leftover materials, keep stock accurate, check material quality, search for materials nearby, request items, and track deliveries. Our goal is simple: prevent good materials from going to waste and help teams reuse what already exists.
vision: Help businesses easily find, check, and reuse leftover materials instead of throwing them away.

team.note: Solo assignment mode: all issues are assigned to the Jira account owner.

workingAgreement.sprintLength: One week for Sprint 1 because it closes the foundation slice; Sprint 2 runs for two weeks.
